stories.title: Define Rate Limit Policy Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define configuration schema for rate limits including per-IP, per-session, and per-endpoint thresholds, time windows, and burst limits.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No existing rate limit config; GAP requires schema definition aligned with FastAPI config patterns

stories.title: Implement Rate Limiting Core Logic
stories.description: Build backend logic to track request counts and enforce limits using in-memory or Mongo-backed counters with TTL-based windows.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/mongo/__init__.py (Mongo available for counters); ASSUMPTION: no existing throttling logic

stories.title: Integrate Rate Limiting via FastAPI Middleware
stories.description: Add middleware in FastAPI main entrypoint to enforce rate limits on incoming requests and return 429 responses when exceeded.

stories.title: Rate Limiting Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating request throttling, burst handling, TTL reset behavior, and correct HTTP 429 responses.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py (existing backend test patterns reused); ASSUMPTION: no current rate limit tests

per_feature.mitigation: Start with conservative limits and log-only mode before enforcing hard blocks
